purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require committed reward source identity. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: committed reward selection or grant event proof
reward source object or battle result identity proof
capture versus combat versus chest discriminator proof
reward preview or offer exclusion proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: resource mutation counted without committed reward identity
reward preview or offer counted as committed reward
any combat victory counted as plunder reward
object category counted without reward commit proof
chest choice counted without selected reward proof
cove.plunder-treasure-bank-gold.notes: Requires committed plunder, treasure-bank, creature-bank, or defeated-neutral reward identity before Prize Shares can grant extra gold; resource mutation and object category evidence alone are not enough.

forbiddenSubstitutes: resource mutation counted without committed reward identity
reward preview or offer counted as committed reward
any combat victory counted as plunder reward
object category counted without reward commit proof
chest choice counted without selected reward proof
stronghold.raid-tribute-income.notes: Requires committed defeated-neutral or capture reward identity before Spoils Ledger can grant raid tribute income; broad all-combat income and raw resource mutation are forbidden substitutes.
